title: Associate Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

As an Associate Project Manager at Snowflake, you’ll be supporting the delivery of our most important customer engagements. This is an exciting early-career opportunity for someone eager to build project and customer delivery skills in the cloud data space. You’ll work closely with senior SDMs, Practice Managers, project teams, and Snowflake customers to ensure projects are well-coordinated, documented, and successfully executed.

In this role, you’ll develop foundational experience across professional services delivery, project coordination, and customer operations—while contributing to customer success at one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies in the world.

This is a hybrid role (3 days a week) in Mexico City

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Support Solution Architects, Practice Managers and Senior Services Delivery Managers in day-to-day project coordination, including scheduling, status tracking, documentation, and internal communications

  • Collaborate with other internal stakeholders such as Consulting Managers, Technical Delivery Directors, Practice Directors and Operations team to ensure projects are smoothly delivered

  • Create, update and track project plans, risks, and action logs

  • Own project reporting and metrics tracking for customer engagements

  • Attend and support customer meetings, capturing notes, follow-ups, and next steps

  • Build an understanding of Snowflake’s delivery methodologies, tools, and best practices

  • Support delivery documentation including statements of work, project artifacts, and customer onboarding materials

  • Participate in internal initiatives to improve delivery operations and customer experience

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Up to 3 years of relevant experience in project coordination, consulting, customer success, or delivery support

  • Demonstrated strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail and follow-through skills

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills in both English and Spanish

  • Comfort working across multiple projects, stakeholders, teams, and tools

  • Proactive, curious, and eager to learn

  • Familiarity with cloud technologies or enterprise software is a plus

  • Bilingual (Spanish and English) required

BONUS POINTS FOR:

  • Experience supporting technical or customer-facing teams

  • Exposure to project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Jira)

  • Understanding of data, cloud, or SaaS concepts

WHY JOIN SNOWFLAKE PROFESSIONAL SERVICES?

  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-paced team that delivers real value to customers

  • Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge data technology

  • Learn from experienced delivery leaders and grow your career in tech

  • Join a supportive, inclusive, and growth-minded culture

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
